transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Well, I guess what brings me in is that I just feel like I’m always moving from one thing to the next. I, uh, I really can’t just sit idle. It's always been a bit like that, but... we have a new work setup recently, and it’s made all of that a lot harder to hide.
{"intent": "Determine whether the restlessness has been present since childhood to evaluate for ADHD versus adult-onset disorders.", "question": "Did you experience this kind of restlessness or

Yeah, looking back, this was around long before this job change. I mean, even back in grade school, my teachers used to write on my report cards that I was bright but careless. I talked out of turn a lot, and they always had to remind me to just stay with my work. So, yeah, it's definitely been there since I was a kid.

```json
{"intent": "Assess for current symptoms of hyperactivity and impulsivity to differentiate between predominantly inattentive and combined presentations.", "question": "In your daily life now as an adult, do

Do I... sorry, do I what? 

If you mean do I still act like that now, I'm not really sure. I haven't noticed anything too extreme. Like I mentioned, I just have a hard time sitting idle at my desk and feel like I always need to be doing something. But other than just needing to keep busy or shifting around a lot, I don't really know what else to look for.
In conversations or meetings, do you frequently find yourself interrupting others or finishing their sentences before they can finish?

Yeah, I suppose I do. I really don’t mean to be rude, but... well, at work, if I hear my coworkers trying to work through a customer problem, I’ll just jump right in with an answer. I do it before they’ve even finished what they're saying, or honestly, before anyone actually asked me for help. It just kind of comes out.
Do you often find it hard to sustain your attention on tasks or work for an extended period?

Yeah, I do. Like, when we have those longer coaching meetings at work, or if I have to read through a new procedure... I usually start off fine. But then, after just a few minutes, I'll realize my eyes are still moving over the words, or I'm still sitting there, but I haven't really taken in a single thing that was said or written. It just doesn't stick.
